summary: Chart-only continuation of the A-share appendix: measured-move worked examples on A-share indices and stocks — 上证 false breakout and trendline breaks (破线) with a converging-triangle target, 创业板 W bottom and H&S top, 沪深300 triangle tops, M top, 下飘旗 flag, H&S bottom with three stacked targets, plus stock examples (国元证券 triangle, 梦牛山 H&S bottom, 深圳惠程 flag + 假突破, 铜陵有色 triangle top, 黑芝麻 上飘旗, 楚天高速 M top). Introduces the 三周低点 (weekly) / 三日低点 (daily) break as a strength gauge during an upward blow-off.

patterns.name_zh: W底 / 头肩底（多重涨幅满足）
patterns.name_en: W bottom / H&S bottom with stacked targets
patterns.structure: Neckline above one or more lows; distance = neckline - low; project from the breakout (or right shoulder) point, repeatedly for 2nd/3rd targets.

target.formula: t1 = breakout_point + (neckline - low); t_n = t_{n-1} + (neckline - low)

confirmation: During an upward blow-off, watch whether the prior 3-week low (daily: 3-day low) is broken as a strength gauge.
invalidation: 跌破前面三周低点 after the final target marked the end of the 沪深300 rally.

patterns.name_en: H&S top / M top measured drop
patterns.structure: Peak(s) over a neckline; distance = head/top - neckline; project from breakdown point, repeated for second target.

target.formula: t1 = breakdown_point - (top - neckline); t2 = t1 - same distance

patterns.structure: Triangle high and low define the height; project from the break point.

target.formula: target = break_point ± (triangle_high - triangle_low); 2nd target adds the same height again

patterns.structure: Bull: leg low -> flag high, down-drifting flag (下飘旗) to flag low; target = flag low + leg. Bear: leg high -> flag low, up-drifting flag (上飘旗) to flag high; target = flag high - leg.
patterns.entry: Flag breakout in the trend direction.

target.formula: bull: flag_low + (flag_high - leg_low); bear: flag_high - (leg_high - flag_low)

invalidation: 假突破 after the target = top (沪深300, 深圳惠程).

rules.rule: When a bull wave blows off upward, use whether the prior 3-week low (3-day low on daily) is broken as the strength/weakness gauge.
rules.quote_zh: 多头波向上喷出时可配合三周低点（日线则三日低点）是否跌破作为强弱势的参考

rules.rule: A false breakout at/after the measured target marks the top (charts: 上证, 沪深300 weekly, 深圳惠程).
Trendline breaks (破线) mark exits/turns after moves (上证日线 multiple 破线 labels).

worked_examples.pattern: 假突破 / 破线 / 收敛三角形

worked_examples.outcome: hit target; 假突破 above it then fell
hit, then 假突破 and crash
hit third target; then broke prior 3-week low

quantifiable: Stacked targets: after a neckline break, t_k = break_point ± k*height for k = 1..3.
Blow-off strength: in a strong up-leg, exit/trim on a weekly close below the low of the prior 3 weeks (daily: prior 3 days).
False breakout after target: new high above the measured target followed by close back below the prior range -> exit/short.
ambiguities: 沪深300周线 M头: printed top label '4850' with neckline 4550 gives a 300-pt height, but targets 3250/1950 imply a 1300-pt height (top ≈ 5850); the chart scale puts the top near 5800-5900, so '4850' looks like a misprint for 5850.
梦牛山 H&S bottom: 6.8 - 5.06 = 1.74; 6.6 + 1.74 = 8.34 and 6.8 + 1.74 = 8.54 — printed target 8.4 does not exactly match either.
Break point used for projection varies: sometimes the neckline value (铜陵有色 3.6), sometimes the actual break price (2135 vs neckline 2115; 2700 for 创业板 H&S; 2010 right shoulder for 沪深300).
No prose in this unit; rules are inferred from chart labels except the 三周低点 annotation.
